propositions: enrichment queue reduce currently opens all matching event files per type per ticket (called 3× per ticket), causing unbounded file-open growth as enrichment reruns accumulate
drain gate `pending_enrichment` budget (20 ms) is chronically exceeded (measured 404–654 ms on live tracker with 3,727 tickets) due to thousands of listdir calls and file opens per invocation
queue reduce can be optimized to newest-first lazy evaluation and bounded suffix scan by exploiting monotonic lexicographic filename ordering (timestamp-prefixed filenames)

claim() arbitration only needs CLAIM events newer than latest ENQUEUE, forming a contiguous suffix; walking newest-first and stopping at enqueue timestamp bounds reads to contention window rather than full history

the optimization requires pinning a coupling assumption: appended event filenames' timestamp prefix must equal the event body's timestamp field, to prevent silent misreduction if future code changes filename structure
